dinakara_bhatta.note: son of Mahādeva; completed his father's Muktāvalī-Prakāśa, whence the name Dinakarī

corrections.claim: Tarkasaṅgraha has a commentary named Āloka
corrections.detail: Āloka is Pakṣadhara Miśra's commentary on Tattvacintāmaṇi. No Tarkasaṅgraha Āloka is catalogued anywhere checked. Removed from the tree.

corrections.claim: Nīlakaṇṭhī and Bhāskarodaya comment on Tarkasaṅgraha
corrections.detail: Nīlakaṇṭhī comments on the Dīpikā (layer 2); Bhāskarodaya is a gloss on the Nīlakaṇṭhī (layer 3). Encoded at their true levels.

corrections.claim: Kiraṇāvalī belongs in the Muktāvalī tree
corrections.detail: Udayana's Kiraṇāvalī is on the Praśastapādabhāṣya (Vaiśeṣika, 10c). A distinct modern Kiraṇāvalī by Kṛṣṇavallabhācārya IS on the Siddhāntamuktāvalī. Both encoded, separately.
Bṛhatī is Prabhākara's (on the Śābarabhāṣya); Ṛjuvimalā is Śālikanātha's, on the Bṛhatī.
Bodhinī is Varadarāja's; Prakāśa is Vardhamāna Upādhyāya's; Makaranda is Rucidatta's. Haridāsa is not attested as a Kusumāñjali commentator — he wrote a Prakāśa on the Tattvacintāmaṇi.
Rāmarudra Bhaṭṭācārya's commentary on the Dinakarī is properly titled Taraṅgiṇī; Rāmarudrī is the patronymic short name. Both recorded.

corrections.claim: Pañcalakṣaṇī, Sāmānyanirukti, Avayava etc. are independent works
corrections.detail: They are named sections of Tattvacintāmaṇi's Anumāna-khaṇḍa, cross-cut by commentary layer. Only Vyutpattivāda and Śaktivāda are standalone; Bādhānta is Rucidatta's at the Āloka layer.

corrections.claim: Mādhava, Āpadeva and Laugākṣi Bhāskara are Prābhākara
corrections.detail: Britannica's page layout places them near the Prābhākara heading. All three are Bhāṭṭa. Any importer reading that page must not infer school from proximity.
